statement: For 2D rectangular knapsack with 8-12 item types, expanding MaxRects from 4 to 8 heuristics with SA over joint (ordering × per-item-heuristic × per-item-rotation) space achieves ~96.5/100. The improvement decomposes as ~55% from expanded heuristics (4→8) and ~45% from SA tuning (faster cooling 0.995, 3 restarts, rotation mode). Both lever types are complementary.
regime: 2D rectangular knapsack, bin 900-2000, 8-12 item types, 1s time budget, MaxRects packer with SA
mechanism: Expanding from 4 to 8 heuristics increases per-item placement options, enabling SA to find better per-item heuristic assignments. Faster cooling (T*=0.995 vs 0.9995) with 3 restarts trades exploration breadth for exploitation depth — appropriate given the larger combinatorial space (8^M vs 4^M for M≈10 item types). Per-item rotation mode adds a third dimension to the SA search that prevents greedy rotation choices from locking in suboptimal orientations.
applicability_bounds: Holds for MaxRects packer under 1s time budget. May not apply with different packing algorithms or much longer time budgets where broader exploration could help.

statement: For 2D rectangular knapsack with 8-12 item types, SA over joint (ordering × per-item-heuristic) space achieves ~95.2/100, a 0.37-point improvement over ordering-only hill-climbing. The per-item heuristic dimension is the key lever; SA over orderings alone matches hill-climbing.
regime: 2D rectangular knapsack, bin 900-2000, 8-12 item types, 1s time budget, MaxRects with 4 heuristics
mechanism: Per-item heuristic selection is the dominant lever.
applicability_bounds: Applies with 4 heuristics. Superseded by RP-5 for 8 heuristics. Score of 95.2 is the 4-heuristic ceiling with default SA parameters; with tuned SA (cooling 0.995, 3 restarts) the 4-heuristic score reaches 95.8 (see RP-5).
